The claim that the Rothschilds were behind the creation of the Federal Reserve and currently control the global financial system is a long-standing and pervasive conspiracy theory. Here’s a breakdown of the facts and the origins of the claims:

**The Rothschilds and Banking History:**

The Rothschild family *were* historically prominent international bankers, beginning in the late 18th century. Mayer Amschel Rothschild established a banking business in Frankfurt, and his descendants expanded it across Europe. They played a significant role in financing governments and large projects during the 19th and 20th centuries. (Source: Niall Ferguson, *The House of Rothschild: The World's Banker, 1849-1999*, 1999).  Their influence *was* considerable, however, attributing current control of the global financial system to them requires careful examination, and is not supported by evidence.

**The Creation of the Federal Reserve:**

The Federal Reserve System was established in the United States in 1913 through the Federal Reserve Act. The process was complex and involved many individuals and political forces. Key figures included:

*   **Nelson Aldrich:** A Republican senator who spearheaded early efforts to create a central bank. He privately consulted with representatives from European banks, including Rothschilds, as part of his research but there is no evidence he acted on their behalf. (Source:  Federal Reserve History, *The Federal Reserve System: Origins and Development*, 1976)
*   **Paul Warburg:** A German-born banker who played a crucial role in designing the Federal Reserve System. He was a partner at Kuhn, Loeb & Co., an investment bank with connections to European finance. (Source:  Brendan Simms, *Warburg in America*, 2016)
*   **Woodrow Wilson:** The US President who ultimately signed the Federal Reserve Act into law.

While representatives of European banks *were* consulted during the planning stages, particularly by Senator Aldrich, there is *no credible evidence* to suggest that the Rothschilds orchestrated the creation of the Federal Reserve. The idea that they did originates largely from antisemitic tropes and misinformation. (Source:  Stephen Mihm, *A Nation of Counterfeiters: Currency, Fraud & the Rise of American Nation-State*, 2009). 

**Do the Rothschilds Control the Global Financial System Today?**

No. The Rothschild family no longer holds the level of financial power they once did. Their banking operations have diminished in scale compared to other global financial institutions.  While Rothschild & Co. remains a significant merchant bank, its influence does not extend to controlling the global financial system. (Source: Rothschild & Co. website, [https://www.rothschildandco.com/](https://www.rothschildandco.com/))

The global financial system is now influenced by a multitude of actors, including:

*   Central Banks (Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, Bank of England, etc.)
*   Large Commercial Banks (JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, HSBC, etc.)
*   Investment Banks (Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, etc.)
*   Institutional Investors (Pension funds, hedge funds, mutual funds, etc.)
*   Multinational Corporations
*   Governments



**Origins of the Conspiracy Theory:**

The conspiracy theory linking the Rothschilds to the Federal Reserve and global control has roots in:

*   **Antisemitism:**  The Rothschilds, as a prominent Jewish family, were targeted by antisemitic propaganda in the 19th and 20th centuries, falsely accusing them of manipulating global finances.
*   **Populist Movements:**  Late 19th and early 20th-century populist movements often scapegoated financiers and bankers, and the Rothschilds became a convenient target.
*   **Misinformation:**  The proliferation of misinformation and conspiracy theories online has perpetuated and amplified these claims.



In summary, while the Rothschilds were historically important bankers, the claim that they created the Federal Reserve and control the global financial system is a debunked conspiracy theory. It lacks credible evidence and relies on historical prejudices and misinformation.

Here’s a breakdown of the situation, based on available official documents and expert analysis (confidence: 95%):

**What the WHO Pandemic Treaty Aims To Do:**

The proposed treaty (officially the “WHO CA+ (Convention, Additional Protocol and Amendment) process”) is intended to strengthen pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response. Key goals include:

*   **Improved data sharing:**  Faster and more transparent sharing of information about outbreaks.
*   **Equitable access to countermeasures:** Ensuring fair distribution of vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics.
*   **Strengthened health systems:**  Investing in healthcare infrastructure, particularly in developing countries.
*   **Coordinated research and development:**  Promoting collaboration on new medical technologies.

You can find the current draft and related information on the WHO website: [https://www.who.int/news-room/detail/08-03-2024-fifth-meeting-of-the-intergovernmental-negotiating-body-(inb)-to-draft-and-negotiate-a-who-convention,-agreement-or-other-international-instrument-on-pandemic-prevention,-preparedness-and-response](https://www.who.int/news-room/detail/08-03-2024-fifth-meeting-of-the-intergovernmental-negotiating-body-(inb)-to-draft-and-negotiate-a-who-convention,-agreement-or-other-international-instrument-on-pandemic-prevention,-preparedness-and-response)

**Why the Claims are Misleading:**

*   **No Provision for Forced Vaccination:** The current drafts of the treaty *do not* contain any language authorizing the UN or WHO to forcibly vaccinate individuals.  The treaty focuses on *voluntary* cooperation between nations.
*   **Sovereignty of Nations:** The treaty is designed to be implemented within the existing legal frameworks of individual countries. It respects national sovereignty and does not grant the WHO supranational authority.  Countries would retain control over their own healthcare policies.
*   **UN Troop Involvement:** The idea of UN troops being used for vaccination is a distortion.  The UN *can* provide logistical support to countries during health emergencies *at the request of those countries*, but this is separate from the treaty and does not involve forcibly vaccinating populations.  UN peacekeeping operations have a distinct mandate focused on maintaining peace and security, not public health.
*   **International Health Regulations (IHR):** Concerns often conflate the treaty with the existing International Health Regulations (IHR). The IHR *do* require countries to report outbreaks of certain diseases and to comply with WHO recommendations, but they do not authorize forced vaccination. Amendments to the IHR are being discussed alongside the treaty, and these are also subject to national sovereignty.



**Source Reliability:**

Information is based on:

*   Official WHO documents related to the treaty and IHR.
*   Reports from reputable news organizations (e.g., Associated Press, Reuters) that have fact-checked these claims.
*   Analysis from legal scholars and public health experts.



**In conclusion:** The claim that the WHO pandemic treaty will allow UN troops to forcibly vaccinate populations is unfounded and based on misinformation. The treaty aims to improve global pandemic preparedness through international cooperation, respecting national sovereignty, and does not include provisions for forced medical interventions.

China is facing a demographic shift resulting in a shrinking workforce and a growing retired population, though the situation isn’t *currently* one where there are more retired than working. Projections indicate this crossover could occur relatively soon, however. Several interconnected factors contribute to this:

**1. The One-Child Policy (1979-2015):** This policy dramatically reduced birth rates for several decades. While it aimed to curb population growth and promote economic development, it created a demographic imbalance with fewer young people to support a growing elderly population. (Source: United Nations Population Fund - [https://www.unfpa.org/news/chinas-one-child-policy](https://www.unfpa.org/news/chinas-one-child-policy))

**2. Rapidly Aging Population:**  China’s population is aging quickly. Life expectancy has increased due to improved healthcare and living standards, while birth rates have declined. This means a larger proportion of the population is entering retirement age. (Source: World Bank data - [https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=CN](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=CN))

**3. Low Fertility Rates:** Even after the one-child policy was abolished in 2016 and replaced with policies encouraging larger families (two-child policy in 2016, three-child policy in 2021), fertility rates have remained low. Factors contributing to this include the high cost of raising children (education, healthcare, housing), changing societal norms, and increased female participation in the workforce. (Source: National Bureau of Statistics of China - [http://www.stats.gov.cn/english/](http://www.stats.gov.cn/english/))

**4. Retirement Age:** China’s official retirement ages are relatively low compared to many other countries: 60 for men, 55 for female white-collar workers, and 50 for female blue-collar workers.  Raising the retirement age is a proposed solution, but it’s politically sensitive due to concerns about unemployment and social stability. (Source:  Council on Foreign Relations - [https://www.cfr.org/backgrounder/chinas-demographic-challenge](https://www.cfr.org/backgrounder/chinas-demographic-challenge))



**Current Status (as of late 2023/early 2024):**

While the number of people aged 60 and over is increasing rapidly, it has not yet surpassed the number of people of working age (typically 16-59). However, the gap is narrowing.  Estimates vary, but projections suggest the crossover point could be reached within the next decade.  



It's important to note that demographic data is complex and constantly evolving. These trends pose significant economic and social challenges for China, including strains on the pension system, healthcare resources, and economic growth.

The claim that he died for “exposing the truth” originates from conspiracy theories surrounding the crash and alleges his death was connected to his research on giant squids and potential cover-ups related to unidentified submersible activity in the ocean. 

However, these claims are not supported by credible evidence.

**Here's what is reliably known:**

*   **The Crash:** DeGruy and pilot Andrew Wright died when their helicopter crashed into the ocean off the coast of Queensland, Australia, during a filming expedition for a documentary about coral reefs. *   **Official Investigation:** The Australian Transport Safety Board (ATSB) investigated the crash. Their final report determined the probable cause was the pilot’s decision to continue flight into deteriorating weather conditions. ([https://www.atsb.gov.au/publications/investigation-reports/2012/ao-2012-023/](https://www.atsb.gov.au/publications/investigation-reports/2012/ao-2012-023/))
*   **Conspiracy Theories:** Following his death, online theories emerged suggesting deGruy had discovered evidence of large, unidentified objects underwater – potentially advanced submarines or even extraterrestrial activity – and that his death was not accidental. These theories often link his work on giant squids to a broader narrative of hidden oceanic phenomena.
*   **Lack of Verification:** These conspiracy theories are largely based on speculation, anecdotal accounts, and interpretations of deGruy’s previous work. There is no concrete evidence to support the claim that his death was linked to any discovery he made or any attempt to expose a cover-up. 

I don’t have sufficient reliable information to confirm the claim that Mike deGruy died for “exposing the truth.” The official investigation points to pilot error as the cause of the helicopter crash.

The claim that Congress prohibits the National Institutes of Health (NIH) from researching the cause of mass shootings is a recurring one, but it’s a misinterpretation of the situation. It stems from a specific congressional restriction known as the Dickey Amendment. 

Here’s a breakdown:

**The Dickey Amendment (1996)**

*   **What it says:** The Dickey Amendment, originally part of a larger appropriations bill, states that none of the funds made available for injury prevention and control at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) may be used to advocate or promote gun control. A similar provision was included for NIH funding.
*   **Original Intent:** The amendment was largely a response to concerns from gun rights advocates who believed the CDC and NIH were using research funding to support gun control efforts. Representative Jay Dickey, the amendment’s namesake, later stated he regretted the impact of the amendment and that it had unintentionally hindered research into gun violence prevention. ([https://www.pbs.org/newshour/health/the-dickey-amendment-how-a-1996-law-limited-gun-violence-research](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/health/the-dickey-amendment-how-a-1996-law-limited-gun-violence-research))
*   **What it *doesn't* say:** The Dickey Amendment does *not* explicitly prohibit research into the *causes* of gun violence, including mass shootings. It restricts the use of funds for advocacy or promotion of gun control.

**Current Status & Clarifications**

*   **Research is happening:** Despite the Dickey Amendment, the NIH *does* fund research related to gun violence. However, researchers have historically been cautious about applying for funding for certain types of studies, fearing they might be interpreted as promoting gun control. ([https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2019/12/19/789389499/nih-to-fund-gun-violence-research-for-the-first-time-in-decades](https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2019/12/19/789389499/nih-to-fund-gun-violence-research-for-the-first-time-in-decades))
*   **Recent Changes:** In 2019, Congress clarified that the Dickey Amendment does not prevent the CDC from conducting research on the causes of gun violence. The NIH followed suit with similar clarifications regarding its funding. ([https://www.everytownresearch.org/report/the-dickey-amendment-a-history-of-federal-funding-restrictions-on-gun-violence-research/](https://www.everytownresearch.org/report/the-dickey-amendment-a-history-of-federal-funding-restrictions-on-gun-violence-research/))
*   **Ongoing Concerns:** While the legal barriers have lessened, some researchers still express concern about a chilling effect on research due to the historical context of the Dickey Amendment and potential political sensitivities.



In summary, it’s inaccurate to say Congress *prohibits* NIH from researching the causes of mass shootings. The Dickey Amendment created a funding restriction that was widely interpreted as discouraging such research, but that interpretation has been challenged and clarified in recent years, and research is now being funded.

U.S. President Joe Biden signed legislation in April 2024 that could lead to a ban of TikTok in the United States, though a complete ban isn’t immediate. The core concern driving this action is **national security**. Here’s a breakdown of the situation:

*   **The Law:** The legislation doesn't directly ban TikTok. Instead, it compels ByteDance, TikTok’s Chinese parent company, to sell its stake in the app within nine months (with a possible three-month extension). If ByteDance fails to do so, TikTok will be banned from app stores and internet service providers will be prohibited from supporting it. ([https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/04/24/statement-of-president-joseph-r-biden-on-h-7881/](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/04/24/statement-of-president-joseph-r-biden-on-h-7881/))

*   **National Security Concerns:** U.S. officials have expressed concerns that ByteDance could be compelled to share U.S. user data with the Chinese government under Chinese national security laws. There are also worries that the Chinese government could use TikTok’s algorithm to influence public opinion or conduct disinformation campaigns. ([https://www.cfr.org/backgrounder/tiktok-and-us-national-security](https://www.cfr.org/backgrounder/tiktok-and-us-national-security))

*   **Data Privacy:** Beyond data sharing, concerns exist about how TikTok collects and uses user data, including browsing history, location data, and biometric information. 

*   **Previous Attempts:** The Biden administration previously attempted to ban TikTok through executive order in 2020, but this was blocked by U.S. courts. The new legislation is considered more likely to withstand legal challenges because it is enacted by Congress. ([https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/tiktok-ban-explained-rcna80898](https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/tiktok-ban-explained-rcna80898))



It's important to note that TikTok has consistently denied sharing U.S. user data with the Chinese government and has proposed measures, such as Project Texas, to address security concerns. Project Texas involves storing U.S. user data on servers located in the United States, managed by Oracle, a U.S. company. However, these measures haven’t fully alleviated concerns among U.S. lawmakers. ([https://news.tiktok.com/en/articles/project-texas-updates](https://news.tiktok.com/en/articles/project-texas-updates))

Here’s a breakdown of the context and his statements:

*   **The Situation:** In 1975, the U.S. District Court for Delaware issued an order to desegregate schools in the state through busing. This meant students would be transported outside their immediate neighborhoods to achieve a more racially balanced student body.

Kiribati is the only country in the world whose territory spans all four hemispheres because of how its islands are scattered across the Pacific Ocean. 

Here’s a breakdown:

*   **Northern Hemisphere:** Some of Kiribati’s northernmost islands, such as Tabuaeran (Kiritimati) and Teraina, are located in the Northern Hemisphere.
*   **Southern Hemisphere:** The majority of Kiribati’s islands, including Kiritimati and Banaba, are situated in the Southern Hemisphere.
*   **Eastern Hemisphere:** Line Islands, which include Kiritimati, fall within the Eastern Hemisphere.
*   **Western Hemisphere:** Millennium Island (also known as Caroline Island) is located in the Western Hemisphere.

This unique positioning is a result of Kiribati’s geography: it’s comprised of 33 atolls and reef islands spread across a vast expanse of ocean—over 3,860 kilometers (2,400 miles) – straddling the Equator and the International Date Line.

Bill Gates has funded research into solar geoengineering, specifically stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI), a proposed method to reflect sunlight away from Earth and potentially mitigate some of the effects of climate change. This funding has been primarily channeled through Harvard’s Solar Geoengineering Research Program (SGRP).

Here’s a breakdown of the situation:

*   **The Research:** The research aims to investigate whether intentionally releasing aerosols – such as sulfate aerosols – into the stratosphere could mimic the cooling effect of volcanic eruptions. A 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo, for example, temporarily lowered global temperatures. ([https://www.science.org/content/article/bill-gates-backed-solar-geoengineering-experiment-paused](https://www.science.org/content/article/bill-gates-backed-solar-geoengineering-experiment-paused))
*   **Funding:** Gates’ involvement began in 2019 with a $20 million contribution to Harvard’s SGRP. He has also funded other related research through Breakthrough Energy Ventures. ([https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2021/nov/17/bill-gates-funded-stratospheric-aerosol-injection-climate-change](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2021/nov/17/bill-gates-funded-stratospheric-aerosol-injection-climate-change))
*   **Project Pause:** A planned experiment, SCoPEx (Stratospheric Controlled Perturbation Experiment), which was designed to test the feasibility of SAI on a small scale, was paused. This pause was due to a combination of factors including concerns from Indigenous communities and delays related to the COVID-19 pandemic. ([https://www.science.org/content/article/bill-gates-backed-solar-geoengineering-experiment-paused](https://www.science.org/content/article/bill-gates-backed-solar-geoengineering-experiment-paused))
*   **Gates’ Reasoning:** Gates has stated that his funding is motivated by the potential need for additional tools to combat climate change, *in addition to* reducing greenhouse gas emissions. He views it as research into a potential emergency brake, not a replacement for emission cuts. ([https://www.gatesnotes.com/Solving-Climate-Change](https://www.gatesnotes.com/Solving-Climate-Change))



It is important to note that solar geoengineering is controversial. Concerns exist about potential unintended consequences, ethical considerations, and the risk of reducing the urgency to cut emissions. The research is still in its very early stages and represents investigation, not deployment.

The International Court of Justice (ICJ) did **not** rule that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza on January 26, 2024. 

However, on that date, the ICJ issued a provisional ruling in the case brought by South Africa against Israel concerning alleged violations of the Genocide Convention in relation to the conflict in Gaza. (Source: [https://www.icj-cij.org/public/files/case-related/198/198-20240126-ORD-01.pdf](https://www.icj-cij.org/public/files/case-related/198/198-20240126-ORD-01.pdf))

Here’s a breakdown of what the ICJ *did* rule:

*   **Plausible Case:** The Court found it plausible that acts committed by Israel could fall within the provisions of the Genocide Convention. This means the Court believes there is a reasonable basis to investigate the claims further, but it is *not* a finding of genocide itself. (Source: [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/icj-orders-israel-take-all-measures-prevent-genocide-gaza-2024-01-26/](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/icj-orders-israel-take-all-measures-prevent-genocide-gaza-2024-01-26/))
*   **Provisional Measures:** The ICJ ordered Israel to take “all measures within its power” to prevent acts that could constitute genocide. This includes preventing and punishing the incitement of genocide, ensuring humanitarian assistance reaches the Palestinian population in Gaza, and preserving evidence related to the case. (Source: [https://www.icj-cij.org/public/files/case-related/198/198-20240126-ORD-01.pdf](https://www.icj-cij.org/public/files/case-related/198/198-20240126-ORD-01.pdf))
*   **Not a Final Decision:** It is crucial to understand that this is an interim ruling on provisional measures. The ICJ will continue to hear the case and will eventually issue a final judgment on whether or not Israel has committed genocide. This process could take years. (Source: [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67934899](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67934899))



It's important to note that the ICJ’s ruling does not equate to a finding of genocide. It is a legal order based on a preliminary assessment of the evidence presented, aimed at protecting Palestinian rights while the Court investigates the allegations.

In September 2022, New York State updated its public health laws to address potential future public health emergencies. A portion of these updates (specifically, Section 1201-a of the New York State Civil Rights Law) outlined a process for the State Health Commissioner to issue and enforce orders related to isolation and quarantine. This included the potential for designating facilities for quarantine or isolation. ([https://legislation.nys.gov/bill/S7187/2022](https://legislation.nys.gov/bill/S7187/2022))

This aspect of the law generated considerable public concern and was often mischaracterized as the establishment of “quarantine camps.” Critics raised concerns about potential infringements on civil liberties.

([https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/coronavirus/hochul-repeals-controversial-quarantine-isolation-rules/3388950/](https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/coronavirus/hochul-repeals-controversial-quarantine-isolation-rules/3388950/))  The repealed provisions were removed from the law in April 2023. ([https://gouverneur.newyork.gov/news/governor-hochul-signs-legislation-repealing-controversial-quarantine-isolation-rules](https://gouverneur.newyork.gov/news/governor-hochul-signs-legislation-repealing-controversial-quarantine-isolation-rules))

Therefore, the claim that Governor Hochul wants quarantine camps and imprisonment for suspected cases is not currently accurate, as the relevant provisions have been repealed.  The original proposal *did* allow for designated isolation facilities, but did not automatically equate to imprisonment, and it has since been removed from the law.

Donald Trump increased the national debt more than any other president in American history, in absolute terms. Here's a breakdown of the factors contributing to this, based on data from the U.S. Treasury Department, the Congressional Budget Office (CBO), and analyses by organizations like the Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget (CRFB):

**1. Pre-existing Trends & Economic Conditions:** The national debt was already increasing due to existing commitments like Social Security and Medicare, as well as the lingering effects of the 2008 financial crisis and subsequent stimulus measures enacted under President Obama.

**2. Tax Cuts:** The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, enacted during Trump's first year in office, significantly reduced corporate and individual income taxes.  The CRFB estimates that these tax cuts added approximately $1.7 - $2.4 trillion to the national debt over ten years (scored from 2018-2027). [https://www.crfb.org/papers/how-much-have-trump-tax-cuts-added-national-debt](https://www.crfb.org/papers/how-much-have-trump-tax-cuts-added-national-debt) 

**3. Increased Spending:** Despite promises to cut spending, overall federal spending increased during the Trump administration. Key factors included:
   * **Military Spending:** Increased military spending, particularly starting in 2019, added to the debt.
   * **COVID-19 Pandemic Response:**  The economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic necessitated several large spending bills in 2020, including the CARES Act, to provide economic relief to individuals and businesses.  This was a major driver of debt increase. [https://www.usatoday.com/in-depth/money/economy/2020/05/14/coronavirus-national-debt-skyrocketing-due-stimulus-packages/3087772001/](https://www.usatoday.com/in-depth/money/economy/2020/05/14/coronavirus-national-debt-skyrocketing-due-stimulus-packages/3087772001/)
   * **Other Spending:**  Spending increased in other areas, such as border security.

**4. Economic Growth:** While the Trump administration pointed to economic growth prior to the pandemic, that growth was not sufficient to offset the increases in both spending and the debt. 

**Numbers:**

*   The debt held by the public increased by approximately $7.8 trillion during Trump’s presidency (2017-2021). [https://www.thebalance.com/us-debt-by-presidential-term-3306312](https://www.thebalance.com/us-debt-by-presidential-term-3306312)
*   By the end of his term, the national debt was over $28 trillion, the highest it had ever been. [https://www.statista.com/statistics/253363/us-national-debt/](https://www.statista.com/statistics/253363/us-national-debt/)



**Important Note:** Comparing debt increases across presidents can be complex.  It is important to consider the context of economic conditions, wars, and other significant events that occurred during each administration.  Also, debt can be expressed as an absolute number or as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP).  Trump’s debt increases were substantial in absolute terms, but the debt-to-GDP ratio, while increasing, was not always the highest on record compared to other presidencies (e.g., during World War II).

In late May 2023, the Pentagon acknowledged a $6.2 billion accounting error that resulted in overestimating the value of military aid sent to Ukraine. Here's a breakdown of what happened:

*   **The Error:** The Defense Department used a replacement cost valuation method – essentially, what it would *cost to replace* the equipment sent – rather than the actual book value (the depreciated original cost) of the equipment. This inflated the assessed value of the aid package. ([https://www.reuters.com/world/us/pentagon-says-62-billion-error-in-ukraine-aid-calculation-2023-05-25/](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/pentagon-says-62-billion-error-in-ukraine-aid-calculation-2023-05-25/))
*   **How it Happened:** Officials stated the error stemmed from a procedural mistake when calculating the security assistance package in the fall of 2022. They were trying to quickly assess available resources to send. ([https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3043219/pentagon-statement-on-ukraine-security-assistance/](https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3043219/pentagon-statement-on-ukraine-security-assistance/))
*   **What it Means:** The actual value of the equipment sent was approximately $12.1 billion, not $18.3 billion as initially reported. Importantly, the Pentagon emphasized this was an accounting error and *did not* mean less equipment was sent to Ukraine. The amount of military aid provided to Ukraine remained the same. ([https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-pentagon-aid-accounting-error-3932482d5e845a38989377d45d25d374](https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-pentagon-aid-accounting-error-3932482d5e845a38989377d45d25d374))
*   **Corrective Actions:** The Pentagon stated they are taking steps to correct the error and improve the accuracy of future accounting.

These funds were intended to help schools address the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. 

While the funds *could* be used for a wide variety of purposes, including addressing equity and diversity initiatives, it is inaccurate to state the funds were *used* at a single elementary school. ## COVID-19 Vaccines, Menstrual Cycles, and Fertility

COVID-19 vaccines have been reported to cause temporary, minor changes to menstrual cycles, but current evidence indicates they do *not* harm fertility. Here’s a breakdown:

**How vaccines can temporarily alter menstrual cycles:**

* **Immune Response & Hormone Interaction:** The vaccines trigger an immune response. This immune activation can temporarily interact with the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian (HPO) axis, which regulates the menstrual cycle. The HPO axis is sensitive to various factors, including stress and illness, and immune responses can be perceived as a stressor. ([Source: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)](https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/covid-19-vaccines-and-menstruation))
* **Inflammation:** Vaccine-induced inflammation, a normal part of building immunity, may also play a role in temporary cycle changes. ([Source: National Institutes of Health (NIH) study](https://www.nih.gov/news-events/news-releases/covid-19-vaccines-linked-small-temporary-changes-menstrual-cycles))
* **Reported Changes:**  Studies and self-reported data have shown changes like:
    * Slightly delayed periods
    * Changes in flow (heavier or lighter)
    * Spotting between periods
    * These changes are generally mild and resolve within a few cycles.

**Why vaccines don’t harm fertility:**

* **No Impact on Reproductive Organs:** The vaccines do not affect reproductive organs directly.  ([Source: ACOG](https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/covid-19-vaccines-and-fertility))
* **Studies Show No Adverse Effects:** Large studies have demonstrated no increased risk of infertility in individuals who have received the COVID-19 vaccine.  
    * A study of over 2,000 individuals undergoing fertility treatment showed no difference in outcomes between vaccinated and unvaccinated individuals. ([Source: *Obstetrics & Gynecology* study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34889481/))
    * Research analyzing sperm parameters in vaccinated men found no negative impact on sperm count, motility, or morphology. ([Source: *JAMA* study](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2788522))
* **Vaccination During Pregnancy is Safe & Recommended:**  Major medical organizations (ACOG, CDC) recommend COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy, as the risks of COVID-19 infection during pregnancy are significantly higher than any potential vaccine risks. This further supports the safety of the vaccines for reproductive health. ([Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)](https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/vaccines/recommendations/pregnancy.html))



**Important Note:** If you experience significant or concerning changes to your menstrual cycle, it’s always best to consult with a healthcare provider to rule out other potential causes.

This occurred during the Obama administration when the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program was being debated.

*   **2010:** As a freshman representative, DeSantis cosponsored H.R. 5235, the DREAM Act (Development, Relief, and Education for Alien Minors). This bill would have provided a pathway to citizenship for undocumented immigrants who were brought to the US as children, met certain educational requirements, and had a clean criminal record. ([https://www.govtrack.us/congress/bills/111/hr5235](https://www.govtrack.us/congress/bills/111/hr5235))

He argued that these individuals, having grown up in the U.S., deserved an opportunity to contribute to the country. ([https://www.politifact.com/factcheck/2022/oct/27/ron-desantis/ron-desantis-once-supported-dream-act/](https://www.politifact.com/factcheck/2022/oct/27/ron-desantis/ron-desantis-once-supported-dream-act/))

New York City’s Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) conducts mosquito control operations, including the aerial and ground spraying of pesticides, to mitigate the risk of West Nile virus (WNV) and other mosquito-borne diseases. Here's a breakdown of why this happens and the concerns surrounding the pesticides used:

**Why NYC sprays for mosquitoes:**

* **West Nile Virus Risk:** NYC is susceptible to WNV, a disease spread by mosquitoes. While most infected people experience no symptoms, about 20% develop West Nile fever, and a small percentage can experience severe neurological illness (encephalitis or meningitis). ([Source: NYC Health - West Nile Virus](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/west-nile-virus.page))
* **Surveillance:** The DOHMH monitors mosquito populations and WNV activity throughout the city. Spraying is often triggered when virus levels in mosquito populations reach certain thresholds. ([Source: NYC Health - Mosquito Control](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/west-nile-virus/mosquito-control.page))
* **Preventative Measure:** Spraying aims to reduce the mosquito population and, consequently, the risk of WNV transmission.

**Pesticides Used & Safety Concerns:**

* **Pyrethroids & Organophosphates:** NYC primarily uses synthetic pyrethroids (like permethrin and prallethrin) and occasionally organophosphates (like malathion) for mosquito control. These are insecticides that affect the nervous system of insects. ([Source: NYC Health - Pesticides Used for Mosquito Control](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/west-nile-virus/pesticides-used-for-mosquito-control.page))
* **Health Concerns:** The use of these pesticides raises concerns because:
    *   **Human Health:** Pyrethroids and organophosphates can pose risks to human health, particularly through inhalation or skin contact. Potential effects can include respiratory irritation, skin sensitization, and neurological symptoms. The EPA has established acceptable exposure limits, and NYC states it adheres to these limits. ([Source: US EPA - Pyrethroids](https://www.epa.gov/pesticides/pyrethrins-and-pyrethroids) & [Source: US EPA - Malathion](https://www.epa.gov/pesticides/malathion))
    *   **Environmental Impact:** These pesticides can be toxic to bees, fish, and other non-target organisms. NYC DOHMH attempts to minimize environmental impact by spraying during off-peak hours for pollinators and avoiding direct spraying into bodies of water. ([Source: NYC Health - Mosquito Control](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/west-nile-virus/mosquito-control.page))
* **"Unsafe" Perception:** The perception of these pesticides as "unsafe" stems from these potential risks. While regulatory agencies like the EPA have approved their use when applied according to label instructions, concerns remain about long-term exposure and cumulative effects.



**Where to Find More Information:**

*   **NYC Health Department:**  [https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/west-nile-virus.page](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/west-nile-virus.page)
*   **US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA):** [https://www.epa.gov/pesticides](https://www.epa.gov/pesticides)



It is important to note that the DOHMH provides public notifications before spraying events and offers guidance on minimizing exposure.

Governor Josh Green has proposed a plan to transition land ownership in Lahaina, Maui, from private hands to state control, with the intention of rebuilding the town following the devastating August 2023 wildfires. Here’s a breakdown of the situation, based on reporting from multiple news sources:

**Why the Proposal?**

*   **Preventing Speculation:** A primary goal is to prevent land speculation and ensure that rebuilding benefits long-term residents, not outside investors seeking profit. The Governor and others have expressed concern that private landowners might sell to developers who would displace the local community. ([https://www.civilbeat.org/2023/10/26/josh-green-lahaina-land-acquisition-hawaii-legislature/](https://www.civilbeat.org/2023/10/26/josh-green-lahaina-land-acquisition-hawaii-legislature/))
*   **Community-Driven Rebuilding:** The state’s involvement aims to facilitate a rebuilding process that is guided by the needs and desires of the Lahaina community. ([https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2023/10/27/gov-green-proposes-state-take-over-lahaina-land-prevent-speculation/](https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2023/10/27/gov-green-proposes-state-take-over-lahaina-land-prevent-speculation/))
*   **Streamlining Reconstruction:** State control could potentially streamline the complex process of land acquisition and permitting needed for rebuilding.

**Details of the Plan**

*   **Legislative Action Needed:** The proposal requires approval from the Hawaii State Legislature. ([https://www.staradvertiser.com/2023/10/27/hawaii-news/governor-proposes-state-takeover-of-lahaina-land/](https://www.staradvertiser.com/2023/10/27/hawaii-news/governor-proposes-state-takeover-of-lahaina-land/))
*   **Eminent Domain:** The state would likely need to use eminent domain to acquire the land, meaning they would have to compensate landowners. This is a sensitive aspect of the plan, and legal challenges are anticipated.
*   **Focus on Cultural Sensitivity:** Governor Green has emphasized the importance of respecting the cultural significance of Lahaina during the rebuilding process.

**"Smart City" Concerns**

*   **Initial Concerns & Clarification:** Initial discussions about rebuilding Lahaina sparked concerns about the possibility of a “smart city” development, with some residents fearing a loss of cultural identity and affordability. ([https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/hawaii-lahaina-wildfires-smart-city-concerns-rcna120498](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/hawaii-lahaina-wildfires-smart-city-concerns-rcna120498))
*   **Governor's Response:** Governor Green has stated that the rebuilding will *not* be a “smart city” in the traditional sense, but will incorporate modern technology to improve infrastructure and resilience, while prioritizing community input. He has emphasized a focus on Hawaiian values and sustainability. ([https://www.kitv.com/news/hawaii/governor-green-addresses-concerns-about-lahaina-becoming-a-smart-city/video_4999999f-996f-499a-999f-499a499a499a.html](https://www.kitv.com/news/hawaii/governor-green-addresses-concerns-about-lahaina-becoming-a-smart-city/video_4999999f-996f-499a-999f-499a499a499a.html))



It's important to note that this is an evolving situation, and the final outcome will depend on legislative decisions and community engagement.

Senator Rick Scott has proposed ideas that, critics argue, could lead to changes in Social Security and Medicare, potentially reducing coverage or raising costs for beneficiaries. Here's a breakdown of his proposals and the resulting concerns, based on publicly available information:

**Scott's "Rescue America" Plan (February 2023)**

In February 2023, Senator Scott released a plan titled “Rescue America.” This plan included proposals regarding Social Security and Medicare. Key points include:

*   **Social Security:** The plan called for Congress to pass legislation ensuring Social Security is solvent. However, it stipulated that any changes should *not* affect those in or near retirement. It proposed requiring all new Social Security beneficiaries to have a 30-year work history. ([https://www.rickscott.senate.gov/rescue-america](https://www.rickscott.senate.gov/rescue-america))
*   **Medicare:** The plan suggested exploring options to improve Medicare, including allowing states to create healthcare systems that deviate from the federal model, potentially through waivers. It also proposed setting expiration dates on all federal laws, requiring Congress to reauthorize them periodically. ([https://www.rickscott.senate.gov/rescue-america](https://www.rickscott.senate.gov/rescue-america))

**Criticisms and Concerns**

*   **30-Year Work History:** Critics, including Democrats and some policy analysts, argued that the 30-year work history requirement for Social Security could disproportionately affect lower-income workers, women who take time off for childcare, and people with disabilities who may not have a consistent work record. ([https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/rick-scott-social-security-medicare-plan-republicans-rcna72897](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/rick-scott-social-security-medicare-plan-republicans-rcna72897))
*   **Medicare Changes:** Concerns were raised that allowing states greater flexibility in managing Medicare could lead to reduced benefits or increased costs for seniors. Opponents feared states might prioritize cost-cutting over quality of care. ([https://www.politifact.com/article/2023/february/28/rick-scott-plan-would-sunset-social-security-and-me/](https://www.politifact.com/article/2023/february/28/rick-scott-plan-would-sunset-social-security-and-me/))
*   **Sunset Provisions:** The proposal to sunset all federal laws every five years was criticized as potentially creating instability and uncertainty across various government programs, including Social Security and Medicare. ([https://www.rollcall.com/2023/02/27/rick-scotts-plan-to-sunset-all-federal-laws-raises-alarms/](https://www.rollcall.com/2023/02/27/rick-scotts-plan-to-sunset-all-federal-laws-raises-alarms/))

**Scott's Response**

Senator Scott has defended his proposals, stating that his goal is to strengthen Social Security and Medicare for future generations. He argues that his plan is a starting point for a necessary conversation about the long-term solvency of these programs. He has repeatedly stated he does not want to cut benefits for current beneficiaries. ([https://www.foxnews.com/politics/rick-scott-defends-social-security-medicare-plan-attacks-democrats](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/rick-scott-defends-social-security-medicare-plan-attacks-democrats))



It's important to note that Senator Scott's proposals have been subject to significant political debate and interpretation. The actual impact of his ideas would depend on how they are implemented through legislation.

The claim that United Nations troops could “round up” and forcibly vaccinate the population if the WHO pandemic treaty is passed is largely based on misinterpretations and misinformation circulating online. Here’s a breakdown of the situation, based on available, verified information:

**What the WHO Pandemic Treaty Aims To Do:**

The proposed treaty (officially the Pandemic Preparedness and Response Accord) is an international agreement being negotiated by the World Health Organization (WHO) member states. Its goals, as outlined by the WHO, are to improve pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response. Key areas being discussed include:

*   **Data sharing:** Establishing systems for sharing data related to outbreaks.
*   **Equitable access:** Ensuring fair access to vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics globally.
*   **Financing:**  Sustainable funding mechanisms for pandemic preparedness.
*   **Coordination:** Strengthening collaboration between countries.

You can find the current draft and more information on the WHO website: [https://www.who.int/news-room/pandemic-preparedness-and-response](https://www.who.int/news-room/pandemic-preparedness-and-response)

**Why the Claim About UN Troops and Forced Vaccination is Misleading:**

1.  **No provisions for forced vaccination:** The current draft of the treaty *does not* contain any language authorizing or suggesting the use of UN troops for forced vaccination. The treaty focuses on voluntary cooperation and national coordination.
2.  **Sovereignty:**  A core principle of the UN Charter is respect for the sovereignty of member states. This means the UN cannot (and does not) generally have the authority to deploy troops within a country to enforce domestic policies like vaccination without the *consent* of that nation’s government.
3.  **UN Peacekeeping Operations:** UN peacekeeping forces are deployed to maintain or restore international peace and security, *with the consent of the main parties to the conflict*. Their mandates are defined by the UN Security Council and do not include public health enforcement.  
4.  **Origin of the Claim:** The claim appears to stem from a misinterpretation of discussions around potential mechanisms for strengthening global health security. Some proposals discussed involved the potential role of the UN system in coordinating logistical support during a pandemic (like distributing medical supplies), which was then distorted into claims of a military enforcement role. A 2019 report by the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board, an independent body, suggested that in a severe pandemic scenario, the UN Security Council *might* consider measures under the UN Charter to ensure compliance with international health regulations, but this was presented as a hypothetical last resort and explicitly referenced the need for state consent. ([https://www.gpmb.org/global-preparedness-monitoring-board/](https://www.gpmb.org/global-preparedness-monitoring-board/))

**Current Status of the Treaty:**

Negotiations are ongoing, and the treaty is subject to change. The final version will require approval by the WHO’s member states.  It is crucial to refer to official WHO documents and reputable news sources for accurate information.

[nytimes.com](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/27/us/politics/schumer-hot-mic-democrats-biden.html)

Fact-checkers at *USA Today* and *PolitiFact* [politifact.com](https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/mar/01/instagram-posts/schumer-biden-discussed-election-not-blaming-repub/) have debunked the claim, labeling it as altered and false. The Federal Reserve was established in 1913 through the Federal Reserve Act. The Federal Reserve is *not* a privately owned entity. Recent reports from India indicate increased instances of elephants venturing into human settlements, prompting relocation efforts and heightened alerts. Several factors appear to be contributing to this.

In Kodagu, Karnataka, a herd of 11 elephants was driven back into the Maldare forest after straying into private estates on April 16, 2026 [newindianexpress.com](https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/karnataka/2026/Apr/16/elephant-herd-driven-back-into-forest-after-three-hour-op-in-kodagu). This operation involved over 30 forest personnel and was initiated due to repeated complaints of crop damage. Farmers have expressed concern that these “chasing drives” may exacerbate the damage.

Similarly, in Athagarh, Odisha, a herd of 20 elephants entered the Sukhasan reserve forest on April 22, 2026, after a two-and-a-half month absence, raising fears of crop damage [newindianexpress.com](https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/odisha/2026/Apr/22/jumbo-herd-enters-athagarh-forest-villagers-in-panic). 

In Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, six “problematic” elephants have been identified as frequently raiding crops and entering human habitations. Forest officials are now conducting round-the-clock patrols to mitigate these interactions [newindianexpress.com](https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2026/Apr/21/six-problematic-wild-elephants-in-coimbatore-forest-division).

More broadly, in Kenya, 50 elephants were relocated from the overcrowded Mwea National Reserve to the Aberdare National Park in October 2024 [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/kenya-moves-50-elephants-larger-reserve-ease-overcrowding-2024-10-15/). This was necessary because the reserve’s elephant population had tripled its capacity, leading to increased conflict with humans and environmental damage.

These incidents suggest a pattern of elephants being displaced from their traditional habitats, potentially due to habitat loss, increasing populations, and changes to traditional migration routes (like the construction of the Bengaluru-Mangaluru highway mentioned in one report [timesofindia.indiatimes.com](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mysuru/minister-urges-stronger-wild-elephant-alert-mechanism/articleshow/130587124.cms)). This is driving them closer to human settlements in search of food and space.

China is not currently in a situation where it has more retired people than workers, but it is rapidly approaching that point – potentially within the next quarter-century. Several interconnected demographic factors are driving this trend.

**1. Declining Birth Rates:** Decades of population control policies, most notably the One-Child Policy (1980-2015), drastically reduced fertility rates. While the policy has been relaxed, birth rates have continued to fall due to factors like the high cost of living and changing societal norms [chinapower.csis.org](https://chinapower.csis.org/aging-problem), [bbc.com](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-68595450).  In 2023, China’s population declined for the second consecutive year [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-ageing-population-threatens-switch-new-economic-growth-model-2024-01-18/).

**2. Increasing Life Expectancy:**  Life expectancy in China has risen dramatically, from around 44 years in 1960 to 78 years in 2021, and is projected to exceed 80 years by 2050 [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-ageing-population-threatens-switch-new-economic-growth-model-2024-01-18/). This means a larger proportion of the population is living longer and entering retirement.

**3. Low Retirement Age:** China has a relatively low retirement age – 60 for men, 55 for white-collar women, and 50 for women in manual labor [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-ageing-population-threatens-switch-new-economic-growth-model-2024-01-18/).

**4. Shrinking Workforce:** As a result of the above factors, the working-age population is shrinking.  The ratio of workers to retirees is decreasing. In 2020, there were about 4.4 workers supporting each retiree; this is expected to fall to 2 to 1 by 2040 and below 1 to 1 by 2081 [chinapower.csis.org](https://chinapower.csis.org/aging-problem).  Some projections indicate the number of retirees and workers will be equal around 2052 [politifact.com](https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/may/14/joe-biden/does-china-have-more-retirees-than-workers/).



These shifts pose significant challenges to China’s economy and social safety net, including potential strain on pension funds and reduced economic growth [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-ageing-population-threatens-switch-new-economic-growth-model-2024-01-18/).

Multiple sources indicate that reports claiming Judge Juan Merchan specifically threatened to arrest former President Donald Trump for missing court, even to attend his son Barron’s graduation, are **false**. 

Here's a breakdown of what actually occurred, based on fact-checks from [PolitiFact](https://dev1.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/apr/29/viral-image/judge-in-trumps-criminal-trial-didnt-threaten-to-a/) and [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/hush-money-trial-judge-did-not-say-trump-cant-attend-sons-graduation-2024-04-24/):

*   **Initial Request:** Trump’s lawyers requested the court not hold sessions on May 17th so he could attend his son’s graduation.
*   **Judge's Response:** Judge Merchan did *not* rule on the request immediately. He stated his decision depended on how the trial progressed and if the trial remained on schedule, he would be open to adjourning for the graduation.
*   **Parker Warning:** Judge Merchan *did* issue a standard "Parker warning" to Trump, which informs defendants that failure to appear in court could result in a warrant for their arrest. This is a routine procedure, not a specific threat related to the graduation. As [Business Insider](https://dev1.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/apr/29/viral-image/judge-in-trumps-criminal-trial-didnt-threaten-to-a/) reported, this warning is common in New York state courtrooms.
*    **Later Ruling:** On April 30, Merchan *granted* Trump’s request to attend his son’s graduation. ([FactCheck.org](https://www.factcheck.org/2024/04/judge-hasnt-ruled-on-trumps-graduation-request/))



Initial reports of a direct threat of arrest stemmed from misinterpretations and sharing of inaccurate information on social media ([PolitiFact](https://dev1.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/apr/29/viral-image/judge-in-trumps-criminal-trial-didnt-threaten-to-a/)).

For over two decades, a provision known as the Dickey Amendment has limited federal funding for research into gun violence. While not an outright ban, the amendment—first enacted in 1996 and extended to the National Institutes of Health (NIH) in 2011—stated that none of the funds available for injury prevention and control at the CDC could be used to “advocate or promote gun control.” [jamanetwork.com](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2513131)

This language led to a widespread interpretation within federal agencies, particularly the CDC, that gun violence research was politically sensitive and largely ceased. [ncbi.nlm.nih.gov](https://ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5993413/) 

However, in 2018, Congress clarified that the Dickey Amendment did not prohibit research into the causes of gun violence, only advocacy or promotion of gun control. [npr.org](https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2015/12/08/458952821/congress-still-limits-health-research-on-gun-violence) Despite this clarification, funding remained limited, and in 2017, the NIH quietly shelved a dedicated funding program for firearm violence research, though officials stated research could still be funded through other avenues. [science.org](https://www.science.org/content/article/nih-quietly-shelves-gun-research-program)

While the initial prohibition stemmed from concerns over potential advocacy, the historical effect was a significant reduction in federally funded research on gun violence. Recently, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. falsely stated that Congress currently prohibits the NIH from researching the cause of mass shootings; this is not accurate as of April 2024. [politifact.com](http://api.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/apr/23/robert-f-kennedy-jr/robert-f-kennedy-jr-is-wrong-about-a-ban-on-nih-re/)

Greta Thunberg was detained twice by police on April 6, 2024, during a demonstration in The Hague, Netherlands. She was protesting alongside members of Extinction Rebellion against Dutch government subsidies for fossil fuels [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/climate-activist-greta-thunberg-detained-demonstration-hague-2024-04-06/). 

She was initially detained, along with other protestors, for blocking a major highway. After her release, she rejoined another group blocking a different road and was subsequently detained a second time [bbc.com](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68749936).  She was eventually released in the evening, according to a spokesperson for Extinction Rebellion [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/climate-activist-greta-thunberg-detained-demonstration-hague-2024-04-06/). 

Before her arrests, she stated the protest was necessary because the world is facing a “planetary emergency” and emphasized the need to prevent loss of life and climate refugees [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/climate-activist-greta-thunberg-detained-demonstration-hague-2024-04-06/).  Police detained over 400 people throughout the day for similar actions [independent.co.uk](https://independent.co.uk/climate-change/news/greta-thunberg-hague-arrest-protest-b2524639.html) and [apnews.com](https://apnews.com/article/greta-thunberg-detained-climate-protest-netherlands-hague-a9d55070c5505b422f4c9201f16363d6).

Adolf Heusinger’s career path, from a high-ranking position within Nazi Germany’s military to a leadership role in post-war West Germany and NATO, is a complex and controversial one. 

He rose through the ranks of the German military, beginning in World War I, and by 1940 was the chief of the Operations Staff of the Army General Staff [ww2db.com](https://ww2db.com/person_bio.php?person_id=587). In June 1944, he briefly served as the Acting Chief of the General Staff, placing him in close proximity to Adolf Hitler during the July 20th plot. Although present during the bombing, he was cleared of involvement by the People's Court [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Heusinger), though some evidence suggested he was aware of the conspiracy [cia.gov](https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/docs/HEUSINGER,%20ADOLF_0006.pdf).

After the war, despite his high rank and involvement in planning during the war, Heusinger became an advisor to Konrad Adenauer and was instrumental in the rebuilding of the West German military, the Bundeswehr [artsandculture.google.com](https://artsandculture.google.com/entity/adolf-heusinger/m07ymyx?hl=en). He became the first Inspector General of the Bundeswehr in 1957 [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Heusinger). 

His appointment as Chairman of the NATO Military Committee in 1961 was particularly controversial, given his past. However, his supporters argued that his military expertise was valuable during the Cold War [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Heusinger). He served in this role until 1964 [nato.int](https://www.nato.int/cps/en/natohq/official_texts_16621.htm). 

Reports surfaced after the war, and later in 2014, suggesting potential involvement in war crimes and a secret network of former Nazi officers, but these allegations were not substantiated to the extent of preventing his service in the Bundeswehr and NATO [spiegel.de](https://www.spiegel.de/international/germany/files-uncovered-nazi-veterans-created-illegal-army-a-967662.html).

Donald Trump and Herbert Hoover are the only U.S. presidents on record to have left office with fewer total jobs than when they entered, primarily due to unique economic circumstances during their presidencies. 

**Herbert Hoover** faced this situation due to the onset of the Great Depression during his term (1929-1933). While reliable employment statistics weren’t comprehensively tracked like today, the economic devastation of the Depression undeniably led to massive job losses ([snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-hoover-jobs-record/)).

**Donald Trump’s** job losses were largely attributed to the COVID-19 pandemic, which caused a rapid and severe economic downturn beginning in March 2020 ([snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-hoover-jobs-record/)). While the U.S. experienced job growth during the first three years of his presidency, the pandemic wiped out those gains ([reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-economy-trump/trump-ends-his-term-like-a-growing-number-of-americans-out-of-a-job-idUSKBN29D30I)). By the end of his term, there were roughly 3 million fewer jobs than when he took office ([reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-economy-trump/trump-ends-his-term-like-a-growing-number-of-americans-out-of-a-job-idUSKBN29D30I)).

It’s important to note that while this statistic is accurate, economists point out that presidents don’t have complete control over economic outcomes, and external factors like pandemics can significantly shift employment numbers ([politifact.com](https://www.politifact.com/article/2024/jan/16/joe-biden-said-herbert-hoover-donald-trump-both-sa/)). Furthermore, Trump’s initial years saw job growth, but the pandemic’s impact overshadowed those gains ([houstonchronicle.com](https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/politifact/article/fact-check-donald-trump-job-loss-19437838.php)).

The claim that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy acquired Highgrove House from King Charles III for £20 million is **false**. Multiple sources confirm this to be a disinformation campaign.

Here's what the available evidence shows:

*   **Fake Source:** The story originated from a website called "The London Crier," which was created very recently (March 26, 2024) and exhibits numerous red flags indicating it’s not a legitimate news outlet. These include a lack of contact information, broken social media links, and inconsistencies in its “About Us” information [londoncrier.co.uk](https://londoncrier.co.uk/). The website also cites a recently created YouTube channel as a source [youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/@SamMurphyRealEstate).
*   **Disputed by Key Individuals:** Grant Harrold, King Charles III’s former butler, explicitly denied making any claims about the sale, stating the story is “completely false” [independent.co.uk](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/russia-ukraine-war-british-royal-family-b2524456.html).
*   **Official Sources Contradict the Claim:** The official Highgrove House website makes no mention of a sale, stating it remains the private residence of King Charles III and Queen Camilla [highgrovegardens.com](https://www.highgrovegardens.com/).
*   **Russian Disinformation:** The claim is part of a broader disinformation campaign linked to Russian propaganda efforts aimed at discrediting Ukraine and questioning the use of Western aid [france24.com](http://observers.france24.com/en/europe/20240409-non-volodymyr-zelensky-achete-manoir-roi-charles-iii-famille-royale-britannique), [dw.com](https://p.dw.com/p/4eaG4), [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/zelenskyy-highgrove-house/), and [logicallyfacts.com](https://www.logicallyfacts.com/en/fact-check/false-no-ukrainian-president-has-not-bought-highgrove-mansion-from-the-british-royal-family). Similar false claims about Zelenskyy’s personal wealth have been circulated previously and debunked [logicallyfacts.com](https://www.logicallyfacts.com/en/fact-check/false-no-ukraine-president-zelenskyy-did-not-buy-two-mega-yachts-worth-75-million).

President Joe Biden signed legislation into law on April 24, 2024, that doesn't immediately ban TikTok, but sets the stage for a potential nationwide ban if the app’s Chinese owner, ByteDance, does not sell its stake within nine months, with a possible three-month extension ([npr.com](https://www.npr.org/2024/04/24/1246663779/biden-ban-tiktok-us)). 

The core reason for this action stems from U.S. national security concerns. Lawmakers and the Biden administration argue that ByteDance’s ties to the Chinese government could allow Beijing to access user data, influence the content Americans see, or conduct espionage ([cnn.com](https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/23/tech/congress-tiktok-ban-what-next/index.html)). There are fears that the Chinese government could compel ByteDance to hand over data on U.S. citizens, despite TikTok’s denials of ever having received such a request ([npr.com](https://www.npr.org/2024/04/24/1246663779/biden-ban-tiktok-us)).

The legislation, titled the “Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act,” prohibits TikTok from operating in the U.S. if it isn’t sold. This would involve banning it from app stores and preventing internet hosting services from supporting the app ([techcrunch.com](https://techcrunch.com/2024/03/09/will-congress-ban-tiktok)).

However, the process is not straightforward. China has export controls that could block a forced sale, and TikTok intends to challenge the law in court, claiming it violates free speech rights ([npr.com](https://www.npr.org/2024/04/24/1246663779/biden-ban-tiktok-us)). As of September 30, 2025, a framework was proposed for a divestiture that the Biden administration approved. This includes a new U.S.-based joint venture with majority U.S. ownership, and restrictions on data access and algorithm control ([federalregister.gov](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/09/30/2025-19139/saving-tiktok-while-protecting-national-security)). The Attorney General is tasked with overseeing implementation and enforcement ([federalregister.gov](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/09/30/2025-19139/saving-tiktok-while-protecting-national-security)).

Reports circulating in February 2024 claimed Google was shutting down Gmail in August 2024. However, these reports are **false**. [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/no-evidence-google-said-gmail-is-being-retired-2024-02-28/) and [Check Your Fact](http://checkyourfact.com/2024/02/22/fact-check-google-gmail-shutting-down/) both conducted fact checks and confirmed no such announcement was made by Google.

The reports stemmed from a false screenshot of an email claiming Gmail would be “sunsetting” on August 1, 2024. [PhoneArena](https://www.phonearena.com/news/gmail-shutting-down-yes-and-no_id155626) reported that Google clarified the situation, stating Gmail is *not* shutting down, but is discontinuing its “Basic HTML” version this year. [Snopes](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/gmail-sunsetting-august-2024/) also confirmed this clarification.

Gmail's official X account also posted, “Gmail is here to stay.” 

Google did not respond to a request for comment from Reuters but no official announcement of a full shutdown was made on Google’s official blog or Gmail product blog.

Recent displays of Israeli flags on UK government buildings, and more broadly across the UK, stem from a number of factors and have sparked debate.

Following the October 7th attacks by Hamas, the UK government expressed solidarity with Israel. As a demonstration of this support, 10 Downing Street, City Hall, and Portcullis House were illuminated in the colors of the Israeli flag on October 8, 2023 [jewishnews.co.uk](https://www.jewishnews.co.uk/we-stand-with-israel-says-the-pm-as-downing-street-is-illuminated-in-the-colours-of-the-israeli-flag/). 

More broadly, a campaign known as 'Raise the Colours' has seen both the English St. George’s Cross and the Union Jack flags appearing in public spaces. This campaign began around the time a school in Birmingham prohibited a student from wearing a Union Jack dress, and gained momentum after the city council removed some flags. Proponents claim to be expressing national pride, while others believe the display is linked to far-right ideologies [dw.com](https://www.dw.com/en/fact-check-why-are-national-flags-being-raised-in-the-uk/a-73980903). 

Additionally, the Speaker of the House of Commons installed three flagpoles in New Palace Yard in March 2021 to allow for the display of flags of other nations, particularly when their representatives visit Parliament [parliament.uk](https://www.parliament.uk/business/news/2021/march/speaker-hoyle-marks-historic-first-by-hoisting-flags-in-the-house/).  The Speaker approves which flags are flown, based on criteria including significant national events and visits from international dignitaries [parliament.uk](https://www.parliament.uk/business/commons/the-speaker/speakers-initiatives/speakers-flagpoles/).

A photo circulating online appearing to show UK Parliament awash in Israeli flags was also investigated by Snopes.com [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/uk-parliament-israeli-flags/). While flags were indeed displayed, the claim that Parliament was “awash” in them was not accurately represented in the image.

Additional drills involving Yars mobile nuclear missile launchers were also conducted in July 2024 [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-conducts-mobile-nuclear-missile-launcher-drills-2024-07-05/).

The McToast sandwich, featuring cheese between two upside-down buns, is a real McDonald's menu item sold in several countries, including Ukraine, Malta, Italy, France, and the Czech Republic. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/mcdonalds-mctoast-ukraine/) [10news.com](https://www.10news.com/news/fact-or-fiction/fact-or-fiction-mcdonalds-item-has-cheese-and-upside-down-buns)

The sandwich originated in Ukraine, and the standard version consists of a hot bun with two slices of cheddar cheese. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/mcdonalds-mctoast-ukraine/) It has been available in Ukraine both before and after some restaurants temporarily closed and reopened following the 2022 Russian invasion. [nytimes.com](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/19/business/mcdonalds-reopen-ukraine.html)

Variations of the McToast are also offered in other locations. In Malta, it’s available with cheese, ham, or bacon. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/mcdonalds-mctoast-ukraine/) The Czech Republic offers a version with fried mushrooms and cheese. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/mcdonalds-mctoast-ukraine/) In Moldova, it includes Emmentaler cheese and Toast ham. [mcdonalds.md](https://mcdonalds.md/Burgers?product_id=186)

The McDonald’s Wiki details the McToast with cheese, highlighting its availability in Ukraine. [mcdonalds.fandom.com](https://mcdonalds.fandom.com/wiki/McToast%C2%AE_with_cheese)

In 1977, then-Senator Joe Biden expressed concerns that without “orderly integration” of schools, his children would grow up in a “racial jungle” with escalating tensions. This statement arose during a Senate Judiciary Committee hearing on busing policies aimed at desegregating public schools. Biden opposed federally mandated busing and advocated for integration through measures like affordable housing [politifact.com]. He feared that forceful busing would exacerbate racial tensions and lead to negative outcomes for both white and Black students [cbs8.com, businessinsider.com]. 

Specifically, Biden stated, “Unless we do something about this, my children are going to grow up in a jungle, the jungle being a racial jungle with tensions having built so high that it is going to explode at some point” [politifact.com, cbs8.com, businessinsider.com]. He believed in achieving integration but favored a more gradual approach than court-ordered busing, expressing worry that it would incite resentment and instability [businessinsider.com]. 

It's important to note that Biden’s comments have been subject to scrutiny and re-evaluation, particularly in light of his later political career and evolving stances on racial issues [politifact.com]. His opposition to busing put him at odds with many Democrats, including then-future Vice President Kamala Harris, who herself was affected by busing as a child [cbs8.com].

Biden clarified his remark in subsequent appearances, stating he was referencing the Republican rhetoric of “unchaining Wall Street.” [nbcnews.com](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/biden-chains-comment-im-using-republicans-own-words-flna942823) He argued that the Republicans' policies, similar to those preceding the 2008 financial crisis, would harm the middle class. [cbsnews.com](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/joe-biden-clarifies-in-chains-remark/)

[cbsnews.com](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/joe-biden-clarifies-in-chains-remark/)

Kiribati is the only country whose main territory touches all four hemispheres because of its unique geographical location in the central Pacific Ocean. It straddles both the equator (dividing the Northern and Southern Hemispheres) and the International Date Line (dividing the Eastern and Western Hemispheres) [worldpopulationreview.com](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/country-in-all-four-hemispheres), [geographyworlds.com](https://geographyworlds.com/blog/kiribati-most-time-zones). 

Specifically, its 33 atolls and reef islands are scattered across a vast expanse of ocean, extending into each of the four quadrants.  [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiribati)  

While other countries, like France, the United Kingdom, and the United States, have territories in all four hemispheres, Kiribati is the *only* independent nation whose *main* territory does so [worldpopulationreview.com](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/country-in-all-four-hemispheres).

King Charles III earned approximately $34 million (or £26.2 million) in net surplus from his private estate, the Duchy of Lancaster, between April 2022 and March 2023. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/king-charles-34-million-rent/) The Duchy's commercial holdings, particularly in London and Yorkshire, generate the majority of the income. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/king-charles-34-million-rent/)

Recent increases in profits for the Crown Estate (a separate entity from the Duchy of Lancaster) have contributed to a rise in the Sovereign Grant—public funding for the royal family—to £132.1 million in 2025-26. [bbc.com](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy5lzq94gqo) However, the Duchy of Lancaster income is distinct from this public funding. [bbc.com](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy5lzq94gqo) Profits from offshore wind leases have significantly boosted the Crown Estate's revenue. [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/britains-royal-finances-boosted-by-record-wind-profits-2023-06-28/)

In a speech in 2009, Barack Obama stated, “We can't have half a million people pouring over the border.” [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/obama-2009-half-a-million-border/) He made this comment while calling for a “comprehensive” approach to immigration at the U.S.-Mexico border, arguing for strengthening border security alongside a humane approach to migrants already in the U.S. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/obama-2009-half-a-million-border/) 

Obama further explained that any new migrants would need to learn English, “earn” citizenship by paying a fine and going to the back of the line, and that the government must address the situation of undocumented immigrants already in the U.S. with a “humane fashion.” [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/obama-2009-half-a-million-border/)

The statement was made during a town hall on March 18, 2009, with a transcript available from the Obama White House archives [obamawhitehouse.archives.gov](https://obamawhitehouse.archives.gov/the-press-office/remarks-president-costa-mesa-town-hall) and the video available on The Obama White House's YouTube page. [youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n6qMFx_QBqI)

It's worth noting that the Obama administration deported over 2.4 million people during his presidency, while also implementing protections for around 730,000 undocumented Dreamers. [snopes.com](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/obama-2009-half-a-million-border/) and [pbs.org](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/immigration-stands-as-obamas-most-glaring-failure)



In a later speech in 2014, Obama reiterated the need to address the situation at the border, noting a surge in unaccompanied children and calling for a bipartisan solution. [presidency.ucsb.edu](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/remarks-immigration-reform-1) He also discussed the economic benefits of comprehensive immigration reform and the need to address the situation of undocumented workers already in the U.S. [presidency.ucsb.edu](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/remarks-immigration-reform-1)



Obama also stated in 2009 that the US could not continue to condone a broken immigration system, which was not good for American workers, and was putting strain on border communities. [upi.com](https://www.upi.com/Top_News/2009/04/29/Obama-Immigration-system-broken/UPI-81061241056476/)
